issue.title: Lifted JOIN predicate is dropped for nested COBOL copybooks
issue.description:
## Summary

`CobolJoinLifter` drops the predicate when the copybook nests, so the translated query returns
every row — see `parser/cobol/JoinLifter.java:212`.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Parse a copybook with a nested `OCCURS` group.
2. Read the generated SQL.

## Expected Behavior

The `WHERE` clause carries the lifted predicate.

## Actual Behavior

The predicate is absent and the query is unfiltered.
